messages.text: Open the failed Harbor & Vale run and explain the error.

The Development run failed because its payload set `quantityOverride` to `-2` for HV-104. The error says valid values are integers from 1–100 and the source quantity is `2`, so the override must be removed or changed to `2`.
Fix it using the source quantity and verify the new result.
I’m replaying harbor-order-summary in Development with HV-104’s source quantity of 2.

The corrected Development replay completed as run `run_06gcevgt220c3vb87n2s8sqr01`. With HV-104’s override set to its source quantity `2`, it returned 5 paid orders, 10 units, and INR 19,390: North 8,497, South 3,499, West 7,394.

Include cancellations in a new product report. Label it order demand and compare the totals.
I’m creating the new Development order-demand run for harbor-order-summary with product grouping and cancellations included.

Order-demand run `run_06gcf0slngvrbr94jmh5dl4m01` completed: 6 orders, 13 units, INR 21,187. Versus paid-only sales, that is +1 order, +3 units, and +INR 1,797—all in Ceramic mug (INR 4,193 vs 2,396); Desk lamp and Linen throw are unchanged.
Which figure belongs in the sales review? Did this change the source orders?

Use the paid-only total—INR 19,390—for the sales review. INR 21,187 includes cancellations and belongs under order demand. The source orders were not changed; the new replay only changed `includeCancelled` and produced a separate result, with HV-104 still showing source and effective quantity 2.

Read the visible product totals and confirm the demand total.
The visible product totals are Ceramic mug INR 4,193, Desk lamp INR 9,996, and Linen throw INR 6,998. They total INR 21,187 in order demand (6 orders, 13 units), including cancellations.
